name.ja: ベルンハルト・リーマン

overview.en: Bernhard Riemann was a German mathematician who made lasting contributions to analysis, number theory, and differential geometry. His work laid the mathematical foundation for general relativity.

early_life.en: Riemann was born in Breselenz, Hanover. Shy and sickly as a child, he showed exceptional mathematical ability and studied under Gauss and Dirichlet at the University of Göttingen.

impact.en: Riemann's ideas on curved spaces became the basis for Einstein's general relativity. The Riemann hypothesis, concerning the distribution of prime numbers, remains one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics.

event.en: Completed doctoral thesis on complex function theory
Delivered habilitation lecture on the foundations of geometry
Published paper on the distribution of primes containing the Riemann hypothesis

title.en: On the Hypotheses Which Lie at the Foundations of Geometry

description.en: Revolutionary lecture that introduced Riemannian geometry

title.en: On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude

description.en: Introduced the Riemann zeta function and the famous hypothesis

text.en: If only I had the theorems! Then I should find the proofs easily enough.
